name: Meta Model API
description: Serves Meta's Muse Spark, Muse Image, Muse Voice Transcribe, and SAM models through Responses, Chat Completions, and Messages-compatible APIs for app and agent developers.

skills.name: Tool Calling
skills.description: Lets Muse Spark call developer-defined functions, including parallel calls with streamed arguments.

skills.name: Image Generation
skills.description: Generates and edits images with Muse Image, refining them across turns on the Responses API.

skills.name: Speech To Text
skills.description: Transcribes live audio over WebSocket or uploaded files with Muse Voice Transcribe, with speaker labels.

skills.name: Media Segmentation
skills.description: Finds and outlines objects in images and video from a short text prompt with SAM 3.1, returning boxes and masks.

skills.name: Search Grounding
skills.description: Grounds responses in real-time web search results with inline citations.
